content.short: TAU Labs designs DeFi products and curates risk-managed vaults across chains.
content.description: TAU Labs, from 628 Labs, designs next-generation DeFi products, covering mechanism design, incentives and token design, and acts as a vault curator running strategies for stablecoins, BTC, ETH and other assets. DefiLlama tracks TAU Labs vaults on Plasma.
